USECASE_COMPARE.NAME: Compare harnesses across topics
USECASE_COMPARE.INTENT: Owner or lecturer opens the comparison matrix to see how multiple harnesses handle a given topic side by side. They can expand individual cells to read the insight and optionally reveal evidence items. The goal is rapid orientation — which harness is different, where, and why.

USECASE_DOSSIER.NAME: Read a harness or topic dossier
USECASE_DOSSIER.INTENT: Owner or lecturer navigates to a harness profile page or topic profile page to read all insights and evidence items for that subject. Insight is always visible; evidence is collapsed under "Show the proof". The goal is depth — everything known about one harness or one topic in one place.

USECASE_DISPATCH.NAME: Trigger an agent job
USECASE_DISPATCH.INTENT: Owner presses a button or relies on a cron schedule to launch an agent job (refresh, discover, verify, explain). The system dispatches the job to the AgentRunner, tracks its status, and surfaces results in the UI when complete. The goal is keeping the observatory's data fresh without manual effort.

USECASE_JOB_DASHBOARD.NAME: Inspect agent job history
USECASE_JOB_DASHBOARD.INTENT: Owner or lead agent opens the Job Dashboard to inspect recent AgentJobs, their status, runner identity, errors, raw logs, and semantic runtime events. The goal is operational transparency from high-level job status down to the project concepts involved in a failure.

USECASE_LIVE_DISCOVERY.NAME: Live discovery during a lecture
USECASE_LIVE_DISCOVERY.INTENT: During a lecture, the lecturer opens Live Agent Studio on a projector screen and assigns a fresh discovery task (e.g. "find an undocumented feature added in the last 7 days"). Students watch the agent work in real time via SSE stream. When a genuine new finding lands, a student-observer can claim first-observer credit; the system generates a ready-to-publish telegram seed. The goal is turning a lecture into a live research session with attributable student contributions.

USECASE_CURATION.NAME: Curate agent-produced insights
USECASE_CURATION.INTENT: Owner opens a workbench queue of proposed or disputed Insights produced by agent jobs, scans their status and evidence count, and applies confidence labels such as human-verified, disputed, or historical. The goal is post-publication curation, not approval gating.

USECASE_LECTURER_DEMO.NAME: Lecturer walks through insight and proof
USECASE_LECTURER_DEMO.INTENT: Lecturer opens a dossier or matrix cell and uses it as a teaching surface. They show an Insight at the top, then click "Show the proof" to reveal the EvidenceItem (file:line citation from upstream). For surprising or contested insights, they press "Ask the agent why" to spawn an explanation job live. The goal is demonstrating agent-first epistemology: assertion on top, evidence below, always reachable.

USECASE_IMPORT_LEGACY.NAME: Import harness-architecture markdown corpus
USECASE_IMPORT_LEGACY.INTENT: Owner runs the importer once (or on demand) to read the existing markdown corpus from the sibling harness-architecture repo — registry, topic files, comparisons — and populate the SQLite database with Harness, Topic, Insight, and EvidenceItem records. This bootstraps the observatory with existing research without manual re-entry.

USECASE_EXPLAIN.NAME: Ask the agent why on an Insight
USECASE_EXPLAIN.INTENT: Any user — owner, lecturer, or student — clicks "Ask the agent why" on an existing Insight. The system spawns a short explain job, the agent reads the insight and its evidence and produces a fresh explanation, which is appended to the insight record and rendered below it. The goal is turning agent uncertainty and surprising claims into on-demand teachable moments without a human having to pre-author the explanation.

FEATURE_MARKDOWN_IMPORT.INTENT: Importer reads harness-architecture registry, topic files, and harness-map comparison and populates the SQLite database with normalized Harness, Topic, Insight, and EvidenceItem records.

FEATURE_COMPARISON_MATRIX_RO.INTENT: Read-only matrix view of harness x topic with dense symbolic cells for scanning and compact expandable detail for the selected cell; the overview stays compact while the side/below detail foregrounds payload, latest/deduplicated explanation, and EvidenceItem proof without repeated scaffolding.

FEATURE_HARNESS_DOSSIER_RO.INTENT: Read-only harness profile page listing all topics covered for that harness with their Insights and collapsed EvidenceItems.

FEATURE_TOPIC_DOSSIER_RO.INTENT: Read-only topic profile page listing all harnesses that have data for that topic, with their Insights and collapsed EvidenceItems.

FEATURE_DASHBOARD.INTENT: Home page showing harness count, topic count, total insight count, and entry links to matrix, harness list, and topic list.

FEATURE_AGENT_RUNNER.INTENT: Abstract AgentRunner Python protocol class defining the interface for dispatching research jobs; v0.2a wires the first manual refresh path through this boundary.

FEATURE_CLAUDE_RUNNER.INTENT: ClaudeRunner concrete implementation of AgentRunner that invokes `claude -p` as a subprocess and streams stdout back to the job record.

FEATURE_CODEX_RUNNER.INTENT: CodexRunner concrete implementation of AgentRunner that invokes `codex exec` as a read-only subprocess and stores stdout/stderr in the job log.

FEATURE_AGENT_JOB.INTENT: AgentJob entity and dispatch mechanism: v0.2 stores the first manual OpenCode refresh lifecycle; v0.3a generalizes the same manual refresh spine to additional harness targets with raw logs, parsed Insight/Evidence artifacts, and semantic events around runtime boundaries.
FEATURE_AGENT_JOB.PRD_REF: docs/PRD.md §7 Core Information Model (AgentJob entity), §18.7 Agent job management

FEATURE_JOB_PREFLIGHT.INTENT: Refresh jobs verify target path and runner readiness before invoking an expensive model call, failing with durable AgentJob evidence when the local environment is stale or misconfigured.
FEATURE_JOB_PREFLIGHT.PRD_REF: docs/PRD.md §4.10 Agent-runner agnosticism, §4.11 Semantic runtime tracing for agents

FEATURE_SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_TRACE.INTENT: Refresh jobs emit append-only semantic JSONL events that name the step, WHY anchor, expected state, actual state, component, and job id; Job Dashboard detail renders those events so future agents and humans can debug from project concepts instead of raw stdout alone.
FEATURE_SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_TRACE.PRD_REF: docs/PRD.md §4.11 Semantic runtime tracing for agents

FEATURE_CRON_SCHEDULER.INTENT: APScheduler integration that registers DB-backed per-harness refresh schedules, exposes next-run metadata, and can be enabled for in-process scheduled dispatch while staying off by default for safe local/test startup.

FEATURE_LIVE_AGENT_STUDIO.INTENT: Projector-optimized SSE streaming UI for live agent runs: select a target and runner, create a live AgentJob, stream AgentRunner events, preserve raw logs, and show the run state to a classroom.

FEATURE_CURATION_QUEUE.INTENT: Workbench queue that surfaces proposed, disputed, verified, and historical Insights through explicit status views with target labels, evidence counts, clear reversible curation actions, and legible Markdown-ish Insight payload rendering. It is not an approval gate; Insights remain visible elsewhere while labels improve trust calibration, and button copy must explain that actions change labels rather than delete agent output.

FEATURE_ABSTRACT_JOB.INTENT: Abstract job type that turns EvidenceItems into diagrams, ascii art, or other higher-level teaching artifacts. The first v0.4b slice can use deterministic artifacts to prove storage, visibility, and traceability before model-backed generation.
FEATURE_ABSTRACT_JOB.PRD_REF: docs/PRD.md §14.2 Job types, §14.2 Job types, §11.8 Live Studio

FEATURE_FIRST_PUBLISH_CREDIT.INTENT: Student attribution on fresh-finding Insights: Insight.first_observed_by field stores the student's name when they claim a discovery during a live session; UI surfaces the attribution visibly.

FEATURE_MULTI_PASS_VERIFICATION.INTENT: Verify job type that runs multiple agent passes on the same question and labels the resulting Insight with a confidence status (proposed / corroborated / disputed) visible in all UI surfaces.

FEATURE_ASK_AGENT_WHY.INTENT: Per-Insight "Ask the agent why" button that spawns a short explain job; the explanation is appended to the Insight record and rendered below it without replacing the original text.

FEATURE_ENGAGEMENT_HOOKS.INTENT: Engagement job type that produces telegram-seed formulations, surprising-fact hooks, and optionally humorous framings for Insights. Published to the DB immediately per L1 auto-merge (PRD §7.3, §11.7) — there is no DB-publication review gate. External publication (e.g. an actual Telegram post) is a separate human action performed by the owner or a student via "claim a finding" in Live Studio; that human step is not the same as a DB approval queue.
FEATURE_ENGAGEMENT_HOOKS.PRD_REF: docs/PRD.md §7 Core Information Model (Insight.engagement_hook, joke_or_telegram_seed), §7.3 Autonomy model (L1 auto-merge), §11.7 Curation Queue (not an approval gate), §14.2 Job types (engagement)

FEATURE_ENGAGEMENT_HONESTY.INTENT: v1.1 honesty pass: UI surfaces that render engagement copy must disclose when the copy is template-generated rather than agent-authored.

FEATURE_PARSER_EMPTY_GUARD.INTENT: v1.1 parser guard: a successful runner result that produces zero parsed Insights and zero EvidenceItems must not appear as a green success; it gets a distinct done_no_findings status plus semantic warning.

FEATURE_EVIDENCE_RICH_VIEW.INTENT: Cell and dossier view with Insight always at top and EvidenceItem collapsed below it; "Show the proof" button expands the file:line citation from upstream. Button label is fixed — it communicates epistemology, not just UI affordance.
FEATURE_EVIDENCE_RICH_VIEW.PRD_REF: docs/PRD.md §4.8 Three-stage learner journey, §11.3 Harness Dossier

FEATURE_CONFIDENCE_BANDS.INTENT: Confidence status label (proposed / corroborated / disputed / human-verified / corrected) visible on every Insight card in matrix, harness dossier, and topic dossier views.
FEATURE_CONFIDENCE_BANDS.PRD_REF: docs/PRD.md §4.9 Agent fallibility as pedagogy, §7.3 Autonomy model

FEATURE_INSIGHT_LIBRARY.INTENT: Insight Library surface for retrieving Insights across harness/topic boundaries with filters for audience and format, including confidence, attribution, and engagement copy.

FEATURE_LENS_SCORING.INTENT: Per-lens scoring v1.0: each harness receives a computed score per topic lens (e.g. agent loop complexity, permission model, prompt engineering surface), stored in the DB and shown in the matrix. The first slice is deterministic and exists to make lens disagreement visible rather than to declare one winner.

FEATURE_DOC_GENERATION.INTENT: Markdown export from DB: generates comparison reports, harness summaries, lecturer briefs, onboarding checklist, and a legacy archive manifest from live DB state. Generated docs are derived artifacts, not the source of truth.

MODULE_IMPORTER.INTENT: Markdown importer: reads harness-architecture corpus (registry/harnesses.md, topics/*/topic.md, topics/*/evidence.md, comparisons/harness-map.md) and populates the SQLite database via SQLModel. Also the entry point for markdown export (doc generation).

MODULE_MODELS.INTENT: SQLModel entity definitions: Harness, Topic, Insight, EvidenceItem, AgentJob. Central schema for all DB reads and writes in the observatory.

MODULE_WEB_APP.INTENT: FastAPI application factory: registers all routers, configures DB engine, sets up optional guarded scheduler lifespan, and serves static assets.

MODULE_SCHEDULER.INTENT: v0.3b scheduler service: reads DB-backed refresh schedules, computes next-run times, registers APScheduler interval jobs, and dispatches through the existing RefreshJobService boundary only when explicitly enabled.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_DASHBOARD.INTENT: FastAPI router for the home/dashboard page: shows harness count, topic count, insight count, and entry links to the major workbench/reference surfaces.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_CURATION.INTENT: FastAPI router for the Curation Queue: lists proposed/disputed Insights and applies confidence labels without hiding the underlying agent-produced content.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_LIVE.INTENT: FastAPI router for Live Agent Studio: creates live AgentJobs, renders the projector surface, streams runner events through SSE while preserving raw logs, and handles first-observer claims.

MODULE_LIVE_SERVICE.INTENT: Service boundary for Live Agent Studio: persists queued live discovery AgentJobs, starts runner.stream only when the SSE endpoint is consumed, writes raw logs, and emits semantic runtime events.

MODULE_ABSTRACT_SERVICE.INTENT: Service boundary for abstract jobs that turn EvidenceItems into higher-level teaching artifacts while preserving source evidence ids.

MODULE_VERIFY_SERVICE.INTENT: Service boundary for verify jobs that record support/dispute passes, update EvidenceItem verification metadata, and derive Insight/ComparisonCell confidence labels.

MODULE_ENGAGEMENT_SERVICE.INTENT: Service boundary for engagement jobs and first-observer attribution helpers.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_INSIGHTS.INTENT: FastAPI router for the Insight Library: filter Insights by audience/format, show confidence/attribution/engagement copy, and dispatch explain jobs for individual Insights.

MODULE_WEB_TEMPLATE_INSIGHT_LIBRARY.INTENT: Insight Library template section that labels deterministic engagement copy as template-generated.

MODULE_WEB_TEMPLATE_LIVE_DETAIL.INTENT: Live Agent Studio detail template section that labels generated telegram seed copy as template-generated.

MODULE_EXPLAIN_SERVICE.INTENT: Service boundary for explain jobs that create a deterministic explanation from an Insight and its EvidenceItems, store a RevisionNote, raw log, and semantic events.

MODULE_LENS_SERVICE.INTENT: Service boundary for default lens seeding and deterministic lens score refresh from current Harness/Topic/Insight/Evidence/ComparisonCell signals.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_LENSES.INTENT: FastAPI router for v1.0 lens scoring: render lenses, per-harness/topic scores, and a deterministic score refresh action without implying a universal winner.

MODULE_DOC_EXPORT_SERVICE.INTENT: Service boundary for generated Markdown exports and legacy archive manifest creation from DB state.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_EXPORTS.INTENT: FastAPI router for generated Markdown exports: trigger generation, list output files, and surface archive/onboarding metadata.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_HARNESS.INTENT: FastAPI router for harness profile pages: list all harnesses and show a dossier for one harness with all its topics, insights, evidence, and revision-note explanations rendered through the shared Insight card.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_TOPIC.INTENT: FastAPI router for topic profile pages: list all topics and show a dossier for one topic with all harnesses that have data for it, including shared Insight-card explanation rendering.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_MATRIX.INTENT: FastAPI router for the comparison matrix view: renders harness x topic grid, handles cell-expand HTMX partials showing insight + evidence, and confidence band labels.

MODULE_WEB_TEMPLATE_MATRIX.INTENT: Matrix page template that renders the dense symbolic scan grid and side detail panel requested during feedback hardening.

MODULE_WEB_TEMPLATE_MATRIX_CELL_DETAIL.INTENT: Matrix selected-cell detail partial that removes duplicated scaffolding and renders the useful summary, explanation, and proof payload compactly.

MODULE_RUNNER_BASE.INTENT: AgentRunner abstract Protocol class defining the interface for all agent runner implementations. No concrete subprocess invocation is allowed below this abstraction boundary.

MODULE_RUNNER_CLAUDE.INTENT: Claude CLI backed AgentRunner implementation. The concrete subprocess invocation lives here and nowhere else.

MODULE_RUNNER_CODEX.INTENT: Codex CLI backed AgentRunner implementation. The concrete `codex exec` subprocess invocation lives here and nowhere else.

MODULE_JOBS_SERVICE.INTENT: v0.2/v0.3 job service: creates manual harness refresh AgentJobs, resolves and preflights target cwd, runs runner preflight, executes via AgentRunner, writes raw logs, emits semantic events, and parses successful logs.

MODULE_PARSER_EMPTY_GUARD.INTENT: Refresh job service branch that turns a parser-zero-artifacts result into done_no_findings plus semantic warning.

MODULE_RUNTIME_SEMANTIC_LOG.INTENT: Append-only semantic JSONL event writer for AgentJob runtime traces.

MODULE_JOB_LOG_PARSER.INTENT: v0.2b parser that turns one real refresh raw log into proposed Insight and EvidenceItem rows while preserving the raw log.

MODULE_WEB_ROUTES_JOBS.INTENT: FastAPI router for Job Dashboard list/detail/log views, including compact semantic event traces for a job.
